contracts.rule: Formal engineering evaluation may read only the frozen 2024-2025 development role.
Formal evaluation requires the versioned split manifest and cannot derive worker-local splits.

The complete CN field inventory includes raw/fabric fields, PIT fundamental sources and representations, chip sidecar fields, plate market fields, PIT membership metadata and true1min plate aggregates; the historical 121-field registry is an input, not the total-table authority.
Presence in the field master inventory does not authorize generator exposure; route eligibility remains controlled by the unified capability registry.
Only registered fields, representations, roles and typed routes may reach formal admission.

nodes.label: Full field universe and route exposure evidence

contracts.rule: The Information Census may measure coverage, variation, entropy and field-to-field redundancy only; returns, labels, reward, validation, holdout and 2026 are forbidden.
A field family without real PIT materialization remains NOT_EVALUATED and cannot be inferred from registry rows, schemas or placeholders.
Generator capacity review measures typed construction, compile legality, root consumption and structural identity only; it cannot make a signal, reward or Alpha claim.

The immutable prepared contract is the ontology proposal-root authority. Its separate active authorization permits bounded development campaigns, while each campaign must still freeze a nonzero budget; schema availability is execution compatibility only and cannot redefine the root scope.

nodes.label: PIT fundamental observable-time and episode authority

contracts.rule: Fundamental level, change and disclosure payloads must resolve through registered observable-time, maturity and unique disclosure-episode semantics; raw source fields and PIT-unresolved families fail closed.
Current-snapshot-only source families cannot claim historical superseded revision replay; zygc_em remains PIT_CONTRACT_UNRESOLVED.
The top-level scheduling key is the unified registry route_id; generation_mode is a route-local action and legacy DEFAULT_ARM_PROFILES are compatibility only.

Pre-admission requires every field actually referenced by the expression to exist in the bound materialized sidecar schema while retaining lineage-only synthetic registry declarations for compiler validation. It uses a bounded label-free behavior probe for exact behavior dedupe; unresolved behavior fails closed and never falls back to structural family. Each final full-coordinate behavior row retains structural family, signal cluster, exact portfolio behavior signature and approximate behavior family as four separate identities.

Feedback-on and feedback-off share seed, master attempt stream, budget, historical archives, dedupe, registry and compiler; only feedback consumption and its adaptive route schedule may differ. PASS binds actual legal/canonical route counts to actionable schedule direction, records supply limits as ACTIONABLE_FEEDBACK_CLAMPED, and excludes MAINTAIN spillover from feedback causality.

Full materialization and train evaluation run only on 77o. After immutable TRAIN_COMPLETE, validation is report-only. One separately authorized fixed 12-pair evaluation used the already-spent 48-date holdout calendar only for non-collapse evidence, with no feedback, scheduler, archive or promotion writes. It does not reopen candidate selection, sealed OOS status or further holdout access. 2026, Strict Stage A, automatic promotion and all validation/holdout-to-search feedback remain forbidden.
contracts.enforced_by: post_train_validation sequential gate, immutable hashes and access receipts

nodes.label: Compositional Stage A route eligibility gate

contracts.rule: A Stage A route receives at most its evidence-bound admitted exact supply; excluded and naturally underfilled budget is never reallocated.
Every formal candidate must carry an immutable registry, compiler, split, release and evaluator receipt.
Primary and route-specific control travel as one pair with identical split, release, PIT clock and eligible support.
The formal evaluator invokes both pair members and computes train-only matched increments on the same coordinates.
Multi-worker formal evaluation partitions candidate pairs, never portfolio shards.

The train role may read only the frozen 2024-2025 development release. Separately bound validation remains report-only after immutable TRAIN_COMPLETE. A one-time evaluation_role=holdout binding evaluated only 12 pre-frozen pairs on the already-spent 48-date calendar, with zero validation/2026 reads and no feedback, scheduler, archive or promotion write. It grants no additional holdout access and no sealed-OOS claim.
contracts.enforced_by: phase3cm streaming access contracts and post_train_validation sequential gate

contracts.rule: Value cohorts may share raw/value DAG nodes, while support, ranking, mapping, portfolio and cost remain isolated by mapping subcohort.
All 16 physical shards preserve the global trade-time barrier before cross-sectional rank and portfolio mapping.
Feedback accepts only PAIR_TRAIN_FEEDBACK_READY primary rows governed by pair-native reward, blockers, support, turnover and RankIC fields after all three receipt hashes validate.
Validation and holdout are report-only and cannot alter reward, scheduler, family decisions or memory.
2026 forward data cannot be read by evaluation, search policy, scheduler or memory.
Engineering qualification does not authorize formal search, promotion or forward opening.
Matched-control engineering evidence cannot write persistent positive, negative or cross-sprint memory.
The formal CLI and module expose no shard-parallel portfolio entry.
A mean of shard-local rewards cannot enter Phase3CN, scheduler, memory or formal evidence.

contract.rule: Only canonical PIT-qualified fundamental representations may enter typed routes; raw 1,227-field exposure and PIT-unresolved families are forbidden.

The scheduler and generator consume the versioned registry route_id as the only top-level search key. Route-local constructor profiles and generation modes cannot become a second scheduling authority.
The field master is authoritative for existence and status; the unified capability registry is authoritative for generator and route eligibility.
Only context-bound tokens with real materialization and explicit roles may enter an Information Census.
Core Pack membership reflects non-performance quality and redundancy gates only and cannot make an Alpha claim.
An exploratory Core Pack cannot itself change field roles, generator exposure, route admission, search budgets or promotion state.
Only information-core roots consumed by the current constructor plus route-required support roots may enter the prepared scope; registry-eligible but constructor-unreachable roots remain held.

The root contract is active ontology authority and its separate authorization permits bounded development execution; every campaign still requires an immutable nonzero budget and grants no promotion or sealed-data access.
contract.enforced_by: development discovery authorization and campaign budget gates

contract.rule: Receipt construction accepts only registry-authorized typed candidates.
Every receipt binds the fixed split manifest hash.
Every generated primary and route-matched control must pass the existing immutable candidate and pair receipt gates before behavior admission.
Stage A eligibility describes only the routes and exact pairs reachable in the frozen current generator output; it cannot claim complete seven-route capability.
Both primary and control receipts must validate before pair formation.
A pair is assigned to exactly one candidate worker and both members are evaluated.
The qualified streaming path evaluates each matched pair under one frozen mapping subcohort and one execution plan.

The campaign may invoke full-coordinate development Phase3CM pair evaluation on 77o. Only after immutable train completion may the same frozen pairs enter the separate automatic report-only validation role, which cannot feed search. Neither role is Strict Stage A or grants promotion or sealed-data access.
contract.enforced_by: cn_iterative_search_v1 frozen contract and post_train_validation sequential gate

Phase3CN consumes only train-only pair-native READY rows; standalone-primary decisions and blockers are diagnostic only.
Validation and holdout cannot enter candidate feedback.
